issuer: the Montana Motor Vehicle Division (Department of Justice)
note: The Montana Code Annotated 2025 on mca.legmt.gov (read 2026-10-30): § 61-5-111 charges $5 a year for a driver's licence and has it expire 12 years or less after issue (or at 75; 8 years for a REAL ID licence), so a 12-year licence at $60 is held (the sum); § 61-5-105 licenses no one under 15 (but for hardship), and § 61-5-133 restricts a licence issued under 18 for its first year or until 18, so a full licence is kept from 16. § 61-12-504 charges $16 for an identification card, expiring 8 years after issue. The motor vehicle division's own fee page refused the request behind a Cloudflare check.

sources.title: MCA 61-5-111, Driver's license fees and expiration
sources.said: driver's license, except a commercial driver's license -- $5 a year or fraction of a year; ... a license expires on the anniversary of the licensee's birthday 12 years or less after the date of issue or on the licensee's 75th birthday, whichever occurs first.

sources.title: MCA 61-5-105, Who may not be licensed
sources.said: who is under 15 years of age unless the person is at least 13 years of age

sources.title: MCA 61-5-133, First year restrictions on driver's license issued to minor
sources.said: restrictions for 1 year from the date of issuance of the license or until the person is 18 years of age, whichever occurs first

sources.title: MCA 61-12-504, Fees for identification cards
sources.said: a fee of $16 must be collected ... An identification card expires on the anniversary of the cardholder's date of birth 8 years after the date of issue.
